from sqlfmt.api import format_string
from sqlfmt.mode import Mode
source = 'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS t (id INT NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(10,2), CHECK (id > 0));'
expected = 'create table if not exists t (\n    id int not null,\n    amount decimal(10, 2),\n    check (id > 0)\n)\n;\n'
actual = format_string(source, Mode())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
